description: 栃木県河川水位・雨量情報システム_指定河川洪水予報 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences and flood] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 栃木県. 栃木県河川水位・雨量情報システム指定河川洪水予報 ※五行川、秋山川については改修中のため、データが正常に表示されない場合があります。 あらかじめご了承ください。. Coverage: 栃木県. The portal files it under the publisher 栃木県. Its tags are 河川, 災害, 防災, 雨量. It offers 15 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-09-10 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Public Data License 1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
